summary: IBM App Connect Operator and IBM App Connect Enterprise Certified Containers Operands is...
description: IBM App Connect Operator and IBM App Connect Enterprise Certified Containers Operands is vulnerable to Log Forging on a request to create a resource.

summary: Control Web Panel (CWP) before webpanel_version 1.30.6 contains an authorization bypass...
description: Control Web Panel (CWP) before webpanel_version 1.30.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the validate() function of api/v1/index.php that allows attackers holding a password-recovery token and a predictable legacy signature to obtain valid remote-API authorization without a proper API key. Attackers can exploit this flaw via the POST /cronjobsusers/ endpoint to add arbitrary cron commands and achieve command execution as the affected hosting account, and can also abuse the same token to access global account-list and account-detail routes exposing usernames, contact emails, and password hashes.

summary: A flaw was found in abrt. abrt-server trusts a client-supplied PID when creating problem dumps...
description: A flaw was found in abrt. abrt-server trusts a client-supplied PID when creating problem dumps over abrt.socket and, running as root, copies that process's /proc data (including environ) into a dump directory owned by the connecting unprivileged user. This allows a local attacker to read environment variables and related metadata of other users' or root processes when abrtd is running.

summary: Control Web Panel (CWP) before webpanel_version 1.30.6 contains a host header injection...
description: Control Web Panel (CWP) before webpanel_version 1.30.6 contains a host header injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate the password-recovery reset URL by injecting the HTTP Host header into the /v1/lostpass/ route's token generation process. Attackers can lure an automated mail-security scanner into visiting the poisoned reset link to exfiltrate the live recovery token, replay it at /login/index.php?acc=newpass to set a new password, and subsequently abuse the File Manager and Crontab modules to achieve command execution as the targeted hosting account.

cwes.name: Weak Password Recovery Mechanism for Forgotten Password

summary: A flaw was found in abrt. The completeness check introduced to mitigate CVE-2026-54228 and CVE...
description: A flaw was found in abrt. The completeness check introduced to mitigate CVE-2026-54228 and CVE-2026-54229 only verifies that a dump directory contains a "count" element, which an unprivileged user can create. This allows a local attacker to bypass the guard and again poison elements in, or seize ownership of, dump directories while privileged ABRT handlers are processing them. Related Problems2 mutating methods remain ungated by the same check.

summary: IBM App Connect Operator and App Connect Enterprise Certified Containers Operands could allow an...
description: IBM App Connect Operator and App Connect Enterprise Certified Containers Operands could allow an attacker with the ability to run HTTP calls within the running container to can make administrative calls to a running IntegrationRuntime.

summary: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway 1.0.0 through 1.0.11 is vulnerable to cross-site scripting. This...
description: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway 1.0.0 through 1.0.11 is vulnerable to cross-site scripting. This vulnerability allows a privileged user to embed arbitrary JavaScript code in the Web UI thus altering the intended functionality potentially leading to credentials disclosure within a trusted session.

cwes.name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation

summary: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway 1.0.0 through 1.1.0 is vulnerable to improper credential handling...
description: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway 1.0.0 through 1.1.0 is vulnerable to improper credential handling because the X-Upstream-Authorization request header can override the gateway-managed upstream credential for OAuth (authorization_code and client_credentials), bearer and basic authenticated gateways, which could allow an authenticated user to cause upstream requests to be made with a different credential and bypass per-user permission and audit attribution.

summary: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway 1.0.0 through 1.0.11 is vulnerable to server-side request forgery ...
description: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway 1.0.0 through 1.0.11 is vulnerable to server-side request forgery (SSRF). This may allow an authenticated attacker to send unauthorized requests from the system, potentially leading to network enumeration or facilitating other attacks.

summary: Missing protection mechanism for alternate hardware interface vulnerability in Johnson Controls...
description:
Missing protection mechanism for alternate hardware interface vulnerability in Johnson Controls iSTAR Ultra and Johnson Controls iSTAR Ultra SE allows CAPEC‑554: Functionality Bypass.

This issue affects iSTAR Ultra: before 6.9.2.CU02; iSTAR Ultra SE: before 6.9.2.CU02.

cwes.name: Missing Protection Mechanism for Alternate Hardware Interface

summary:
Authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability in Apache APISIX.



On routes using jwe-decrypt...
description:
Authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability in Apache APISIX.



On routes using jwe-decrypt with strict: false and a
forward_header distinct from the token header an unauthenticated
client can supply the value the upstream treats as gateway-decrypted
plaintext. Similar can happen when forward-auth is configured with allow_degradation: true, and the auth service is unavailable.



This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 3.18.0 through 3.19.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.

summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the MPEG-4 Form spatial...
description: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the MPEG-4 Form spatial-constraint handlers in src/compositor/mpeg4_form.c that lets attackers crash the process via unchecked group lookups. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene whose Form constraints reference a non-existent group, crashing tools like MP4Box during chapter import for denial of service.

summary: llama.cpp builds b1886 through b7445 contain a race condition use-after-free vulnerability in the...
description: llama.cpp builds b1886 through b7445 contain a race condition use-after-free vulnerability in the LLaMA-Android JNI wrapper where bench_1model() and free_1context() lack synchronization, allowing Thread A to operate on freed memory while Thread B concurrently frees the llama_context. Attackers can exploit this by performing heap spray with attacker-controlled data containing a fake vtable to hijack the vtable pointer at offset +0x30, causing llama_batch_allocr::clear() to dereference arbitrary memory and achieve remote code execution.

cwes.name: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization
